notes.decision: Greek loanword καιρός 'appointed time, decisive moment.' Translated 'moment' to capture the punctual sense, not generic 'time.'

Per accumulated vocabulary 'depart upward / be raised up / ascend.' Here used of the primordial Darkness ascending against the Light at the cosmogonic onset — the foundational event narrated retrospectively in this kephalaion.

ⲟⲩⲱⲗⲡ̄ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ = 'reveal/uncover forth' (Crum 'reveal, uncover'); functions like ⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ. Recurs four times on this page (lines 18, 22, 27, 32) as the technical verb for the Father's eschatological self-disclosure.
'His hidden storehouses' — the cosmic ⲧⲁⲙⲓⲟⲛ (already in vocab) into which the gathered powers withdraw at the consummation. The hiddenness language (ⲍⲏⲡ) marks the eschatological storehouse motif.
Causative ⲥⲉⲍⲉ ⲁⲣⲉⲧ⸗ 'set on the feet of' (cf. accumulated ⲥⲉⲍⲱ ⲁⲣⲉⲧ⸗ 'set on his feet'). Each cosmic being is set upright in its proper place at the eschatological reordering.
Standard prophetic-apocalyptic formula 'what has happened and what shall happen.' The apostles' commission spans both retrospective and predictive disclosure.
Feminine 'the first (one),' likely referring to the primordial event — the first cosmogonic moment (the depiction of all things by the Father, line 1) which the apostles are commissioned to declare.

Per accumulated vocabulary: Lycopolitan plural of ⲓⲱⲧ 'father' = 'all the Fathers,' i.e. the divine emanations. The page closes on a phrase that opens a new sentence about the time of all the Fathers.
